summary.headline: Advantia Health captures $0.78M in annual savings across 8 sourcing categories
summary.narrative: Through Treya Partners’ strategic sourcing initiative, Advantia Health has locked in $684,936 of recurring annual savings already flowing to the P&L and has a further $95,337 in additional savings moving through final negotiations. The effort spans eight actively-worked categories, with six fully finalized (Billing/RCM, Medical Supplies, Sonography Services, IUD Order Management, Bayer IUD Program and Lab Services) and two late-stage initiatives (IT Managed Services and Lab Reagents & Tests). Key wins include a 9 % fee reduction with Athena for revenue-cycle management, a distributor consolidation yielding 14 % on medical supplies, and redesign of sonography staffing that will trim costs by 19 % while improving care delivery.

category_results.status_notes: Athena fee reduced to 3.15 % effective 9/1/22; retroactive pricing addendum in place
Competitive bid and distributor consolidation (McKesson in Heartland) live 10/31/22
In-house recruiting model 50 % deployed; full transition by year-end
Policy change to 5-unit order threshold implemented 7/11/22
Enrolled in Bayer ‘Confidence in Coverage’ on 7/11/22
BAFO completed; Advantia retained LabCorp at improved rates effective 10/15/22
RFP responses under analysis; savings based on benchmark comparison
Negotiation round held and supplier response received; follow-up pushed to summer ’23
